name: Savage Coast
summary: Along Stranglethorn Vale’s western shore, danger follows the Savage Coast from Westfall toward Grom'gol Base Camp. Crocolisks, basilisks, and hostile troll tribes make the beaches perilous.

sections.title: A Treacherous Strand
sections.body: The Savage Coast follows the western edge of northern Stranglethorn Vale. Its beaches run south from the cliffs by Westfall toward Grom'gol Base Camp. Crocolisks and stonestalkers roam among tide pools and drift logs, while territorial jungle troll camps threaten anyone walking the shore. Beyond the sand, the water deepens toward the submerged dangers of the Vile Reef.

faq.answer: The Savage Coast follows the western ocean edge of northern Stranglethorn Vale. It begins near Westfall's border and runs south past the waters near the Vile Reef toward Grom'gol Base Camp.

faq.q: What creatures live along the Savage Coast?
faq.answer: Crocolisks and basilisks prowl the shore. Hostile troll tribes keep camps beyond the waterline and along the nearby jungle bluffs.

faq.q: Is the Savage Coast safe for travelers moving south from Westfall?
aliases: can you walk to stranglethorn from westfall
faq.answer: No. The coast offers a route around the dense canopy, but amphibious predators and troll warriors make the way dangerous for travelers.

faq.q: What landmarks are near the Savage Coast?
faq.answer: The sunken Vile Reef lies offshore, and Grom'gol Base Camp sits farther south along the coast. To the north, bluffs rise toward Westfall's farmlands and coast.

angles.text: The northern stretch of the coast lies just above Grom'gol Base Camp. Nearby wildlife and aggressive troll bands near the Great Sea threaten the outpost.
Along the shoreline, you can track, skin, and tame crocolisks and basilisks.
